meta.title: Compression tiers & workbench
meta.description: Five-tier context compression plus a workbench: the vial above the composer shows live usage and the system / tools / messages split, one skin pair follows DSH's own light / dark switch (daylight crystal in light, deep obsidian in dark) and repaints the whole DSH app through the host theme service. A reasoning slider under the official model menu's reasoning-level row changes the session's reasoning effort in place. Tiers switch from the Compression tiers panel in the sidebar and apply to every preset engine at once, no restart, with automatic pressure compaction kept on each tier; the five pages of that panel also show project memory for the selected workspace (a 200-line / 25 KB injected-index budget, promises, drift and offline consolidation), edit the global AGENTS.md and the supplement block at the top of each registered workspace's AGENTS.md, detect or download six managed components (GitHub CLI, git, ffmpeg/ffprobe, Python, and the ComfyUI and ComfyUI MCP source trees — resumable, rollback on failure, managed copy first on PATH), download a local model (FLUX.2 [klein] 4B, 4-step distilled, kept in its own models folder below the download root), and show GitHub token scopes and the network check; the repository pill above the input decides where github_push publishes. Tools: compression_tiers, compression_context, compression_compact, github_push. It downloads components from GitHub releases and archives, gyan.dev and python-build-standalone, and the model from the ModelScope mirror; with the plugin off, tiers stop syncing, managed directories leave PATH, and the tools and panel disappear. Limits: tiers assume 256k-token windows or more and only preset-isolated engines are updated; the vial reads official context projections and shows a dash when they are missing.
